status: DRAFT - reviewer-set TYPICAL ADULT SIZES, not from an anthropometric dataset. They are starting points: the user scales every stamp. Maintainer may adjust.

default_press.soft: weight spread evenly over the stamp shape (bodies, hands)
default_press.rigid: everything under the stamp sinks the same distance (plates, blocks)

stamps.name: Fingertip
stamps.note: Below ~3 cells wide on most lattices - expect the 'too small to predict well' flag.

stamps.name: Foam-test foot (ASTM D3574 IFD)
stamps.note: The indentor the foam industry uses for IFD ratings - lets results be compared with foam spec sheets.

import.svg: outline only; closed paths filled; the SVG's own units if present, otherwise the user sets the size
import.image: PNG/JPG; alpha or dark pixels = contact; GREYSCALE = relative pressure (darker presses harder), normalised so the total equals the stated weight; the user sets the real width in mm
